action.prompt: Before this session ends, persist your handoff: 1) what was accomplished, 2) current initiative/gate status, 3) proposed next actions (phrased as proposals for the human to confirm), 4) key metrics or environment changes. Never include secrets, credentials, or real PHI/PII; reference them by ID. WHERE: if you are the only active session, update .kiro/steering/next-session-prompt.md. If other sessions are active (other files exist in $(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/codifide-sessions/, or you are working in a session/<id> worktree), write ONLY to that directory as <your-session-id>.md and do not touch next-session-prompt.md. The human-named integrator consolidates session files into next-session-prompt.md at merge time.
